sloka: इत्युक्त्वा नरशार्दूलो बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा ।स निशश्वास ताम्राक्षो नाग: क्रुद्ध इव श्वसन् ॥ २.९२.२७॥
transliteration: ityuktvā naraśārdūlo bāṣpagadgadayā girā ।sa niśaśvāsa tāmrākṣo nāga: kruddha iva śvasan ॥ 2.92.27॥

translations.english: Thus spoke Bharata, the best of men, with his eyes reddened and voice choked with sobs and hissing like a king cobra.
